purpose: Independently decompose the report-only near-unit physical normalized bath Euler residual from the valid actual H4F3d6 SUBSET into frozen step-linear interval-H physical-clock mismatch and sampled current FD4 derivative defect. No changes to physical GE05 action, Repair24/26 R1 ODE, H3F/H3G, GE19 six-piece source, old science targets or Noether coefficient.

physical_clock_and_ODE.original_time_variable: s=t/tau, with h=H*tau and each frozen step_linear_nd subinterval using h_mid=geometric_mean(H_i,H_i+1)*tau
physical_clock_and_ODE.original_stepper_equation: d z/ds=v; d v/ds=-3 h_mid v-r^2(z-X), with X linearly sampled per interval, unchanged
physical_clock_and_ODE.left_right_one_sided_ODE_current_derivat: J_t,side=3 H_i a_i^3 v_i/tau + a_i^3[-3 h_mid,side v_i-r^2(z_i-X_i)]/tau^2
physical_clock_and_ODE.boundary_nodes: At first and final grid nodes use only their available adjacent interval. For interior nodes report BOTH one-sided original intervals; do not average or secretly choose the smaller defect.
physical_clock_and_ODE.relative_scales: Report original H4F3d6 natural norm ||kinetic||+||potential||, plus each independent component in absolute L2. Do not normalize by an outcome-selected denominator.

cohorts.beta: bath parent is beta-independent; its 3 beta H4F3d6 entries are duplicated views, not 18 independent bath trajectories
cohorts.phase_bin_assignment: For interval i use omega_j * (x_i+1-x_i)/geometric_mean(H_i,H_i+1). Preset bins <0.25, [0.25,0.5), [0.5,1), >=1. Report per-frequency bin/endpoint/interior and all nodes; no exclusions.
cohorts.natural_time_grids: Exact original H4F3b Nt128/Nt64 x arrays with no interpolation of one source term only.

outcomes.FD4_INTERVAL_ODE_DISCREPANCY_DECOMPOSED: All exact physics/provenance/decomposition gates pass. Freeze independently measured FD4 defect and one-sided interval-H mismatch for the original physical data. The ratio may remain near unity: not a physical on-shell PASS and not a full H4 Noether certificate.
